questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Please explain: *
questions.answer: A mix of interesting courses, a love to nature and a good social study environment.

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: That there would be possibilities of making trips during the stay, and that it was close to nature.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:

questions.answer: The first week was a "buddy-week" where all international students were gatheret in groups. Here we got a lot of information, and got to meet a lot of people in the same situation.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Use the studying facilities. You can borrow books for most of the courses in the library 
2. Use ESN to meet other international students and to do fun events
3. Find an association. there are a lot of good ones.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The community I got in the ESN (Erasmus student network) and the trips I made

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: To be continously active and meet new people all the time
